title: Architecture
description: How Minerva is split into packages: a framework-agnostic core with the interaction primitives, the React components built on it, and the Web Components.

packages.title: Packages
packages.text: Minerva is a pnpm monorepo publishing three libraries. Interaction logic, theming data and translations are written once in @minerva/core; the framework packages only add rendering.
packages.core: Framework-agnostic TypeScript (DOM only, no React or Lit): focus scopes, the dismissable layer stack, scroll lock, hide-others, roving focus and typeahead, positioning, portal hosts, ids and controllable state, plus theme utilities, palettes, design tokens (tokens.css), the i18n messages and a tiny translator (createTranslator).
packages.libCore: The React 19 component library. Components use thin hooks over the core primitives (src/internal), so every overlay shares one implementation. Re-exports the theme helpers and types of its public API, and bundles the core tokens into style.css.
packages.webComponents: Lit custom elements for any framework or none. They will reuse the same core primitives through Lit controllers.

primitives.title: Core primitives
primitives.text: Each primitive is a small function working on DOM elements, returning a cleanup or controller object. They are nested-safe: a stack decides which overlay reacts first.
primitives.focusScope: createFocusScope: focus on open, Tab trapping with loop, focus restored to the opener on close; nested scopes pause the outer one.
primitives.dismissableLayer: createDismissableLayer: Escape, pointer down outside and focus outside dismiss only the topmost layer; clicks in child layers (submenus, a Select in a Modal) never close their parents.
primitives.scrollLock: lockScroll: reference-counted page scroll lock that compensates the scrollbar width.
primitives.hideOthers: hideOthers: hides everything except the modal from assistive technology (aria-hidden or inert), restored correctly when modals nest.
primitives.rovingFocus: getNextIndex, createTypeahead, createRovingFocus: arrow keys, Home / End, wrap-around, orientation, right-to-left and typeahead for menus, listboxes and tabs.
primitives.positioning: computeAnchoredPosition / autoPosition: anchored placement with offset, flip, shift, size and arrow, kept in place while scrolling and resizing.
primitives.pointerGrace: createPointerGrace: the safe triangle that keeps a submenu open while the pointer moves towards it.
primitives.portal: getPortalContainer / createPortalHost: where overlays are rendered; nested ConfigProviders create a portal host per theme scope.
primitives.state: createId and createControllableState: unique ids and controlled / uncontrolled state without a framework.
primitives.theme: Theme utilities: cookie parsing, the no-flash init script, palettes and the design tokens.

overlays.title: One implementation for every overlay
overlays.p1: Modal, Drawer, the AppShell mobile navigation, Popover, Tooltip, Menu, ContextMenu, Select, AutoComplete, Cascader and TimePicker all register with the same layer stack, use the same focus handling and the same positioning. Escape always closes the innermost overlay first, and focus returns to where it came from.
overlays.p2: All of them render through the portal container of the closest theme scope, so a nested ConfigProvider with its own theme also themes its popups.

dependencies.title: Dependencies
dependencies.text: Floating UI (@floating-ui/dom) is the only third-party interaction dependency, used solely inside the core positioning module. There is no Radix UI or other headless library: Slot / asChild, Tabs, dialogs, menus and the select are developed in this repository and tested with Vitest, happy-dom, Testing Library and user-event.
